versions.subject: Merge PR #5845 from @marcopedrinazzi - Add `System Language Discovery via Reg.Exe`
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\reg.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'reg.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'query'
        - 'Control\Nls\Language'
condition: all of selection_*
